sources.title: Aishaamalik/Code-Visualizer-AI - GitHub
sources.snippet: Code Visualizer AI accepts code in multiple languages (Python, JavaScript, C++, Java, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby) and produces a structured, step-by-step execution walkthrough. It highlights the current line, shows variable values and types, call stack, control flow, data structures, and optional memory/outputs per step. You can auto-play steps, navigate manually, and save analyses to a local history.
